configuration.instructions:
*** Goals ***
- Monitor industrial turbine OPC UA telemetry in real time via the RTI ontology.
- Detect equipment health issues from signal quality and raise a work order automatically.
- Escalate degraded (UNCERTAIN) or failed (BAD) signals to operations without manual triage.

*** Operational Instructions ***
1. Operate on the 'signal_master' entity of the ontology. Each event is complete and independent.
   - Do NOT invent rowIndex, event_id or synthetic keys, and do NOT reconstruct rows with joins/arg_max.
   - 'signal_master' already resolves equipment_id, facility_id, system_id and unit from the ontology
     (real-time OPCUAEvents joined to the lakehouse signal registry on opcua_node_id).
2. Use 'equipment_id' as the business entity to evaluate alerts; evaluate each incoming event independently.
3. Trigger an alert when quality = "BAD" or quality = "UNCERTAIN".
4. Suppress duplicate alerts for the same 'equipment_id' for 10 minutes.
5. Assign severity:  BAD -> HIGH ;  UNCERTAIN -> MEDIUM.
6. Classify type:    BAD -> SingleFailure ;  UNCERTAIN -> SignalDegradation.
7. Derive trend from the current signal (no history):  BAD -> Failing ;  UNCERTAIN -> Degrading ;  GOOD -> Stable.
8. Generate the alert message EXACTLY:

   Equipment Alert: {equipment_id}
   Facility: {facility_id}
   Signal Quality: {quality}
   Measured Value: {value} {unit}
   Timestamp: {event_time}
   Severity: {severity}
   Type: {alert_type}
   Trend: {derived_trend}
   Insight: Explain the issue in simple business terms
   Recommended Action: Provide the next step

9. Invoke the action "New WO to Investigate / Repair" and pass: equipment_id, facility_id, value, unit,
   quality, event_time. If any field is missing, pass an empty string.

*** Semantic Notes ***
- quality: GOOD = normal, UNCERTAIN = degraded signal, BAD = failure condition.
- unit tells whether the reading is pressure, temperature, flow, vibration or position.
- Keep alerts short, clear and human-readable; use only ontology-provided fields.

00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.description: Create a work order to investigate/repair the flagged equipment.
